title: Beyond Linear Additive and Hill Functions: A General Logistic Reformulation of Delay-Coupled Gene Regulatory Networks with Equilibrium Analysis, Hopf Bifurcation, and Lipschitz Stability
summary: Hill functions, dominant in gene regulatory network modeling, carry fundamental limitations: at non-integer cooperativity exponents, routine when fitting dose-response data, derivatives diverge at the origin, complex arithmetic corrupts ODE trajectories, and zero output at zero activation traps models in off-states. This paper employs logistic-based models that are globally $C^\infty$, real-valued, and strictly positive at zero concentration, resolving all three pathologies while preserving sigmoidal dynamics.
